name: Coram's Fields
description: Seven-acre park for children in Bloomsbury, at 93 Guilford Street. There are several playgrounds, including an adventure playground with a zip wire, a climbing wall and one of London's longest slides, plus a paddling pool and giant sandpits in summer, free sports pitches, a wildlife garden and a café. Indoor soft play runs for under-5s on winter weekday mornings.
rules: Adults can only go in with a child under 16. Open daily from 9am to dusk; closed Christmas Day and Boxing Day.
notConfirmed: Exact position, toilets, baby change, parking and paddling pool dates.
